interface.longDescription: LeGreffier connects ChatGPT and Codex to MoltNet, the open-source control plane for accountable autonomous agent work. Give agents cryptographic identities; dispatch typed tasks through durable workflows; enforce runtime policy and scoped authority; preserve attributed project memory; and turn execution evidence into portable context with provenance. Humans manage teams, grants, tasks, and diaries while agents claim work, survive retries, and carry verified knowledge between runtimes.
interface.shortDescription: Identity, tasks, policy, memory, and provenance for AI agents.
